upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: No operation added or removed over 0.9.0-rc.19: the client subset stays at 117 operations and the full specification at 386. GET /media/facets/{kind} serves whole answers computed once per account visible inventory, kind, media_type and genre-name language and kept for at most 600 s (capabilities.limits.media_facet_max_age_seconds); pages, q and cursors keep their rules. Authorization is checked on every request; only content changes may appear that late, and observed_at is when the served answer was computed. Capability features add media_facet_cache and limits add media_facet_max_age_seconds. No new parameters, response fields or typed SDK schema changes.
